meta.title: Novel creator workbench
meta.description: A three-column long-form writing workbench: works, a Markdown chapter tree, an editor with preview, and boards for characters, character quests, the eight-step character arc, maps, events, relationships, items, plotlines, foreshadowing, tension, and hooks, plus AI rewrite, expansion, analysis, and next-step suggestions for a preview selection, and reviewed AI incremental updates for the story boards. Every chapter is a Markdown file and every change can be committed to Git.
